purpose.statement: Add a compact two-line epic-cycle summary to workflow-bearing session cards while preserving ordinary chat cards unchanged.
purpose.why:
The larger epic-cycle goal depends on humans being able to supervise many agents from the chat surface. Before this slice, a managed run looked like an ordinary conversation, so fleet progress and the task goal were hidden behind navigation and operators could not quickly spot the session that needed attention. The two-line summary turns the existing session list into an honest supervisory overview without burdening normal chats.

If omitted, the larger goal cannot truthfully claim this endgame: Studio and bp chat consistently expose compact, live-and-cold epic progress on workflow sessions; ordinary sessions remain visually and structurally unchanged; deeper drill-down remains separate follow-up work.
